scope: Executed non-fitting reproducibility checks of the released scientific scripts and saved results.

commands.name: compatibility
commands.pass_type: analytical bound, precision checks and figure

scientific_data_integrity.digest_convention: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines: lowercase_file_sha256 + two spaces + repository-relative POSIX path + newline; sorted by path

limits: The full PDE scenario sweeps and nonlinear calibration searches were not rerun in this audit; their archived results are supplied.
The two --help commands check command-line parsing, not scientific calculations.
Timings are observations from this execution and are not performance guarantees.
Numerical consistency and data-integrity checks do not constitute new experimental validation.
